questions.q: The FIXO screens the entry pass. Tap where the RIGHT ALA stays.
questions.explain: Right. The RIGHT ALA stays with their own player, so nobody is left free.
choiceExplanations: The FIXO already screens the PIVOT. Two on him leaves Blue's RIGHT ALA free.
Right. The RIGHT ALA stays with their own player, so nobody is left free.

questions.q: Put the FIXO's jobs in order, from first to last.
options: Blue passes back behind the press
The ball switches to the right
questions.explain: Right. First deny the entry, then recover goal-side when the ball changes side.
choiceExplanations: Right. First deny the entry, then recover goal-side when the ball changes side.
Blue passes back only after the FIXO has blocked the entry pass.
The switch comes after Blue passes back behind the press.
The FIXO recovers last, once the ball has switched sides.

questions.q: The ball switches and Blue's PIVOT drops deeper. Drag the FIXO to guard him.
options: The middle, away from the PIVOT
Between the PIVOT and our goal
questions.explain: Yes. The old screen no longer works, so the FIXO recovers goal-side of the PIVOT.
choiceExplanations: Our RIGHT ALA already presses the passer. The PIVOT would be free behind you.
